pokemon.descriptionEn: The strongly recommended first partner in Pokopia. Its Farming specialty accelerates crop growth and unlocks early automation. Assigning Bulbasaur to a crop habitat is the fastest way to secure Wheat, Beans, and other vegetables needed for mid-game badge requirements.
pokemon.descriptionZh: Pokopia 首選初始夥伴。擁有「栽種」專長，可加速農作物生長並解鎖早期自動化生產。在農耕棲息地指派妙蛙種子，是最快取得小麥、豆子等中期徽章材料的方法。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The evolved form of Bulbasaur. Maintains the Farming specialty with improved efficiency. Unlocked at Friendship Level 5 by providing the correct habitat conditions. Its more developed flower bulb enables higher-yield harvests.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 妙蛙種子的進化型。保留「栽種」專長且效率更高。在友情等級達到 5 級並滿足對應棲息地條件後解鎖。發育更完整的花苞使其能帶來更高產量的收穫。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The final form of the Bulbasaur line. Requires Friendship Level 10 and an advanced habitat configuration to attract. Venusaur's full-bloom flower makes it the most productive farming partner in the game.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 妙蛙家族的最終型態。需要友情等級 10 級並搭配高階棲息地配置方可吸引。完全盛開的大花朵使妙蛙花成為遊戲中生產效率最高的農耕夥伴。

pokemon.descriptionEn: A key industrial partner. Charmander's Burn ability lets Ditto delegate ore smelting and brick kiln-baking. Attract it by building a 啾啾餐 habitat with appropriate fire-themed furnishings. Encountering and earning its trust also teaches Ditto the Fire Breath move for direct terrain interaction.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 關鍵的工業生產夥伴。小火龍的「燃燒」能力讓百變怪得以將礦石冶煉與磚塊窯烤工作委託給牠。透過建造「啾啾餐」棲息地可吸引小火龍。與牠建立信任後，百變怪也能學到「火焰吐息」技能，直接用於地形互動。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The evolved form of Charmander. Unlocked at Friendship Level 5 with an upgraded fire habitat. Its intensified flame makes it more efficient at smelting high-grade ores.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 小火龍的進化型。友情等級 5 級並升級火焰棲息地後解鎖。增強的火焰使其在冶煉高等礦石方面效率更高。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The final form of Charmander. Requires Friendship Level 10 and a large fire habitat to attract. Dual Burn and Fly specialties make Charizard a versatile partner for both industrial smelting and aerial traversal tasks.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 小火龍家族的最終型態。需要友情等級 10 級與寬大的火焰棲息地方可吸引。同時具備燃燒與飛行雙專長，使噴火龍成為工業冶煉與空中移動的多功能夥伴。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The first Pokémon Ditto encounters in Withered Wasteland. Rescuing a dehydrated Squirtle teaches Ditto the Water Gun move — essential for watering dry land, growing grass habitats, and eventually triggering the first rainfall to save Onix. A tutorial-critical partner.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 百變怪在枯萎荒野遭遇的第一隻寶可夢。救援一隻脫水的傑尼龜，讓百變怪學會「水槍」技能——這是澆灌乾旱土地、生長草地棲息地，乃至最終引發降雨拯救大岩蛇的必要技能。教學流程的核心夥伴。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The evolved form of Squirtle. Unlocked at Friendship Level 5. Provides stronger water output for irrigation and habitat construction.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 傑尼龜的進化型，友情等級 5 級後解鎖。提供更強的出水量，有助於灌溉與棲息地建設。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The final form of Squirtle. Requires Friendship Level 10 and an advanced aquatic habitat. Its powerful twin cannons make it the most efficient water-supply partner for large-scale irrigation and habitat construction.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 傑尼龜家族的最終型態，需友情等級 10 級與進階水系棲息地。強力雙砲提供遊戲中最高效率的水源供給，適合大規模灌溉與棲息地建設。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Part of the celebrated early automation trio alongside Aipom and Garbodor. Pikachu's Generate specialty powers automation facilities and contributes to the town's electrical grid. A unique individual named Peakychu — an electricityless Pikachu — also appears as a named story character on Bleak Beach and later joins the Huge Building construction crew in Sparkling Skylands.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 與長尾怪手、灰塵山並稱的早期自動化三人組核心成員之一。皮卡丘的「發電」專長可驅動自動化設施並為城鎮電網供電。此外，有一隻名為 Peakychu 的特殊個體——一隻無法發電的皮卡丘——會作為具名劇情角色出現在荒涼海灘，之後加入閃耀空島摩天大樓的施工團隊。

pokemon.descriptionEn: An early encounter in Bleak Beach. Building Meowth a shelter equipped with a Mushroom Lamp is one of the first objectives in the region, calming the beach atmosphere. Meowth also has the Search specialty, helping locate hidden items and resources in the environment.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 在荒涼海灘的早期遭遇。為喵喵建造配有蘑菇燈的避難所是該地區的早期目標之一，有助於安撫海灘的整體氛圍。喵喵還擁有「搜尋」專長，能協助定位環境中隱藏的道具與資源。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Found in Rocky Ridges. The Crush specialty allows Geodude to break rock formations and assist in opening new paths through rubble-filled ruins.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 出現於岩石山脊。「粉碎」專長允許小拳石破壞岩石地形，協助在廢墟遺跡中開闢新通道。

pokemon.descriptionEn: A critical partner for concrete production in Sparkling Skylands. Only Golem's powerful Crush ability can shatter hard rock formations to yield Limestone — the raw material needed for the Concrete Mixer. Recruit one from Rocky Ridges and station it near the mixer in the Skylands.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 閃耀空島混凝土生產的關鍵夥伴。只有隆隆岩強大的「粉碎」專長才能擊碎堅硬岩層，產出混凝土攪拌機所需的石灰岩原料。從岩石山脊招募後安置於空島攪拌機附近。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Discovered in the crater pit in Palette Town after completing the main story. Build an Industrial Warehouse habitat (requires metal barrels, tangled wires, a control unit, and a lamppost) to recruit it. Teaching Ditto the Magnet Rise technique is transformative: press Y to instantly dismantle and recycle blocks; hold Y to remotely grab and reposition entire trees or boulders — completely revolutionizing large-scale terrain modification.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 完成主線後在真新鎮的太空船坑洞中發現。建造「工廠倉庫」棲息地（需金屬桶、凌亂電線、控制單元與路燈）即可招募。讓百變怪習得「電磁飄浮」技能後效果驚人：按 Y 鍵可瞬間破壞回收方塊；長按 Y 鍵可隔空抓取並移動整棵樹木或巨石——徹底顛覆大規模地形改造的體驗。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The emotional centerpiece of the Withered Wasteland tutorial. Trapped underground by extreme drought, rescuing Onix by completing the Water Gun watering sequence and triggering rainfall is the first major milestone of the game. Prefers dry rocky environments — do not place adjacent to water-loving Squirtle as this causes comfort conflicts.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 枯萎荒野教學段落的情感核心。因極端乾旱被困地下的大岩蛇是遊戲第一個重大里程碑的主角：完成水槍澆灌流程、引發降雨後即可將牠救出。大岩蛇偏好乾燥岩石環境，切勿將其與喜好水分的傑尼龜安置相鄰，否則會造成舒適度衝突。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The backbone of the lumber production chain. Build a habitat with one large tree and four tall-grass plots to attract Scyther. Learning Cut from it allows Ditto to split logs into small wood blocks. Scyther can then be commissioned for batch lumber processing — essential for the Thunder Badge (×20) and Sparkling Skylands 4F construction (×20).
pokemon.descriptionZh: 木材生產鏈的核心。建造包含一棵大樹與四格高草叢的棲息地可吸引飛天螳螂。向牠學習「居合斬」後，百變怪可將圓木劈成小木塊，再委託飛天螳螂批量切割成木材。對雷電徽章（×20）和閃耀空島 4F 建設（×20）都不可或缺。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Found in Rocky Ridges. Essential for the copper smelting chain: lure Magmar to a furnace and have it smelt copper ore into copper ingots. These ingots are required to craft the Frying Pan, which is used to cook the Burger Patty that upgrades Ditto's Rock Smash ability — a pivotal progression gate.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 出現於岩石山脊。銅錠冶煉鏈的關鍵：將鴨嘴火獸引至熔煉爐，委託其將銅礦冶煉成銅錠。銅錠用於製作平底鍋，再以平底鍋烹調漢堡排並食用，強化百變怪的碎岩能力——這是遊戲中至關重要的進度關卡。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The player character. This Ditto awakened alone in a post-apocalyptic Kanto after humanity fled to space, discovered an abandoned Pokédex, and used its Transform ability to assume a human-like appearance. It learns abilities from other Pokémon through direct interaction, making it uniquely adaptable. Guided by Professor Tangrowth, Ditto's journey is to restore the world and release Pokémon back into a living environment.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 玩家所扮演的角色。這隻百變怪在人類逃往外太空後獨自甦醒於後末日的關都大地，發現了廢棄的寶可夢圖鑑，並以「變身」能力模仿人類外貌。牠透過與其他寶可夢直接互動學習各種技能，具有獨特的適應力。在巨蔓藤博士的引導下，百變怪踏上了復育世界、讓寶可夢重回生機大地的旅程。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Encountered upon entering Palette Town's Pokémon Center — no special condition required. Eevee's Trade specialty makes it a key NPC bartering partner in the endgame sandbox. All 8 eeveelution habitats share the same base recipe: 1 chair, 1 table, and 1 unique food item unlocked by a specific gameplay milestone.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 進入真新鎮寶可夢中心即可遭遇，無特殊解鎖條件。伊布的「交易」專長使其成為終局沙盒中的重要以物易物夥伴。全部 8 種伊布進化型態的棲息地皆以相同基礎配方為起點：1 張椅子、1 張桌子，以及 1 種需透過特定遊玩里程碑解鎖的獨特食物。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Eevee's water-type evolution. Unlock condition: build 10 water-type habitats in Palette Town to unlock the Ice Cream Soda recipe — the food item that draws Vaporeon to your habitat.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 伊布的水系進化型。解鎖條件：在真新鎮建造 10 個水系棲息地，解鎖「冰淇淋汽水」食譜——這是吸引水伊布前來棲息地所需的特定食物。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Eevee's electric-type evolution. Unlock condition: lay a total of 100 electrical facility blocks throughout Palette Town to unlock the French Fries recipe.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 伊布的電系進化型。解鎖條件：在真新鎮鋪設合計 100 個電力設施方塊，解鎖「炸薯條」食譜。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Eevee's fire-type evolution. Unlock condition: commission Pokémon to assist in construction tasks 15 times to unlock the Pizza recipe.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 伊布的火系進化型。解鎖條件：委託寶可夢協助建築施工合計 15 次，解鎖「披薩」食譜。

pokemon.descriptionEn: A named story character — a Snorlax so overgrown with moss and foliage that it resembles a living hill. Mosslax slumbers on Bleak Beach and must be roused during the 'Brighten Things Up!' power-restoration quest before the town can be illuminated.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 具名劇情角色——一隻渾身覆滿苔蘚與草木、外形宛如一座小山丘的卡比獸（Snorlax）。Mosslax 沉睡於荒涼海灘，必須在「Brighten things up!」發電復原任務中將其喚醒，城鎮才能被點亮。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The legendary Ice Bird of Kanto. Blueprint found inside a yellow Poké Ball at one of the three island peaks in Palette Town. Altar construction requirements — Freezing Chambers: 50 stone, 50 ice blocks, 10 crystal shards, 10 Pokémetal. Articuno's arrival dramatically cools its surrounding environment.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 關都傳說三神鳥中的冰系神鳥。藍圖藏於真新鎮三大島嶼高峰之一的黃色精靈球中。建築需求——冰結之室：50 個石頭、50 個冰塊、10 個水晶碎片、10 個寶可金屬。急凍鳥降臨後會大幅降低周圍環境溫度。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The legendary Electric Bird. Altar construction requirements — Abandoned Power Plant: 50 copper ingots, 50 iron ingots, 50 sea glass shards, 50 bricks, 10 Pokémetal. Requires 15 Pokémon simultaneously on-site with specialties covering Build, Generate, Crush, and Fly. If your region lacks Pokémon with these specialties, manually migrate them from other regions. Encountering Zapdos last among the three Kanto legendary birds unlocks the Tidal Bell recipe, which summons Lugia.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 關都傳說三神鳥中的電系神鳥。建築需求——廢棄發電廠：50 個銅錠、50 個鐵錠、50 個海玻璃碎片、50 個磚塊、10 個寶可金屬。需要 15 隻寶可夢同時在場施工，涵蓋建造、發電、粉碎與飛行四大專長。若所在區域缺乏特定專長的寶可夢，必須手動從其他區域遷移。若閃電鳥是最後一隻遭遇的關都傳說鳥類，將解鎖「海神鈴鐺」製作配方，可召喚洛奇亞。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The legendary Fire Bird. Altar construction requirements — Altar of Flame: 50 copper ingots, 50 gold ingots, 50 lava rocks, 10 Pokémetal. The altar's footprint is enormous (approximately 33×35 grid squares) — many players choose to build it over the volcanic crater, but lava flow management through excavated moats is required for safe construction.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 關都傳說三神鳥中的火系神鳥。建築需求——烈焰祭壇：50 個銅錠、50 個金錠、50 個熔岩岩石、10 個寶可金屬。祭壇佔地極廣（約 33×35 格），許多玩家選擇在火山口上方建造，但必須事先開鑿深溝進行熔岩疏導，以確保施工安全。

pokemon.descriptionEn: An essential partner for Sparkling Skylands traversal. Build a Waterside Boat habitat to attract Dragonite. Learning its Glide ability allows Ditto to soar between the floating islands — without it, many platforms in the Skylands are unreachable and the Huge Building quest cannot progress.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 閃耀空島探索不可或缺的夥伴。建造水邊小艇棲息地可吸引快龍。學習其「滑翔」技能後，百變怪即可在各漂浮島嶼之間翱翔——若未習得此技能，許多空島平台無法抵達，且重建巨大建築任務也無法推進。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The climactic encounter at the peak of Sparkling Skylands. After completing the 4th floor of the Huge Building — requiring 40 concrete, 15 glass, 10 paper, 10 bricks, 20 lumber, and the construction team including Peakychu from Bleak Beach — ascend to the rooftop to find Mewtwo waiting. One of the most powerful legendary encounters in the game.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 閃耀空島的頂點遭遇。完成摩天大樓 4F 建設（需 40 混凝土、15 玻璃、10 紙張、10 磚塊、20 木材，並組成包含從荒涼海灘護送而來的 Peakychu 在內的施工團隊）後，步上屋頂即可發現等待已久的超夢。遊戲中最震撼的傳說寶可夢遭遇之一。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The ultimate secret of Pokopia. Hidden in Withered Wasteland behind a cracked wall (north of the Pokémon Center, past a metal net cut by upgraded Slash). At the end of the underground passage, a mural with 27 Unown-shaped slots awaits. Collect 27 unique Mysterious Slates from glowing golden dig sites scattered across the world — carry a Pokémon with the Search specialty or use a Dowsing Machine to find sites faster. Place all 27 slates correctly to summon Mew, who will appear and ask to become your partner.
pokemon.descriptionZh: Pokopia 的終極秘密。藏身於枯萎荒野地下——從寶可夢中心右側碎磚路北行，以碎岩擊穿裂岩後，再以強化版居合斬切開金屬網，在地下通道底部找到有 27 個未知圖騰形插槽的神秘壁畫。在世界各地的「發光黃金挖掘點」收集 27 塊不重複的「神秘石板」（攜帶搜尋專長的寶可夢或使用尋寶機器可加速收集）。將全部 27 塊石板正確放入壁畫，夢幻便會現身並詢問是否願意成為您的夥伴。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The dedicated source of Wool (絨毛) — one of the materials required for the Thunder Badge (×5). Build a Mareep habitat and periodically harvest its fleece; the wool supply replenishes naturally over time. A steady Mareep operation removes a significant logistics bottleneck in mid-game badge preparation.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 絨毛的專屬來源——雷電徽章所需物資之一（×5）。建造咩利羊棲息地並定期收割羊毛，羊毛供應會隨時間自然補充。穩定的咩利羊運作能消除中期徽章準備過程中的重要物流瓶頸。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Together with Pikachu and Garbodor (灰塵山), Aipom forms the celebrated early automation trio that veteran players rush to assemble. Its nimble tail-hand keeps production lines fed, allowing resource gathering to run automatically once the right habitat is in place.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 與皮卡丘、灰塵山（Garbodor）共同組成著名的早期自動化三人組，是老玩家開局急於湊齊的組合。長尾怪手靈巧的尾巴手能持續供應生產線，建好對應棲息地後即可自動化進行資源採集。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Eevee's psychic-type evolution. Unlock condition: have a Pokémon roommate living with you in your residence. Additionally, Espeon only generates during daytime hours. Unlock food: Afternoon Tea Set.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 伊布的超能力系進化型。解鎖條件：在居所中擁有一隻寶可夢室友同住。此外，太陽伊布僅在遊戲白天時段生成。解鎖食物：下午茶組。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Eevee's dark-type evolution and the most demanding eeveelution to attract. Unlock condition: lay 300 physical road blocks throughout Palette Town to unlock the Chocolate Cookies recipe. Umbreon only appears at night — plan your visits accordingly.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 伊布的惡系進化型，也是最難吸引的伊布型態。解鎖條件：在真新鎮鋪設合計 300 個實體道路方塊，解鎖「巧克力餅乾」食譜。月亮伊布僅在遊戲夜間時段生成——請據此規劃前往時機。

pokemon.descriptionEn: A named story character — an artistically gifted Smeargle. Smearguru's paint-tipped tail lends a creative hand to the town's decorative and customization features, helping you make each restored settlement your own.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 具名劇情角色——一隻才華洋溢的圖圖犬（Smeargle）。Smearguru 以沾滿顏料的尾巴，為城鎮的裝飾與自訂功能增添藝術色彩，協助你打造獨一無二的復興聚落。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The first legendary Pokémon encounter in the story. After illuminating Bleak Beach by connecting all renewable energy sources, climb to the clifftop to witness Raikou for the first time. For recruitment, enter the Pikachu Doll Dream Island (Ocean variant) via Drifloon, navigate deep into its cave, and use the Burger Patty–enhanced Rock Smash to clear metal blocks. Successfully recruiting Raikou dramatically boosts the environment level of your region.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 主線流程中第一隻登場的傳說寶可夢。在荒涼海灘完成所有再生能源串聯、點亮城鎮後，攀爬懸崖頂端即可首次目睹雷公。招募路線：透過飄飄球進入「皮卡丘娃娃夢境島（海洋型）」，深入洞穴深處，以漢堡排強化後的碎岩擊破金屬方塊。成功招募後可大幅提升區域環境等級。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The legendary guardian of the seas. Summoned by crafting the Tidal Bell (海神鈴鐺). The Tidal Bell recipe unlocks when Zapdos is the last of the three Kanto legendary birds encountered (i.e., after Articuno and Moltres have already been met). Craft the bell and ring it near the ocean to call Lugia from the depths.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 傳說中的海洋守護神。透過製作「海神鈴鐺」來召喚。海神鈴鐺的製作配方在閃電鳥成為最後一隻被遭遇的關都傳說鳥類時（即已先遭遇急凍鳥與火焰鳥）解鎖。製作後在海岸邊搖響鈴鐺，洛奇亞便會從深海中現身。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The legendary rainbow Pokémon. Summoned by crafting the Clear Bell (透明鈴鐺). The Clear Bell recipe unlocks after successfully recruiting the third Johto Legendary Beast from the Dream Islands (e.g., after Raikou, Entei, and Suicune have all been recruited). Craft the bell and use it to call Ho-Oh down from the heavens.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 傳說中的彩虹神鳥。透過製作「透明鈴鐺」來召喚。在夢境群島成功招募第三隻城都傳說三聖獸（即雷公、炎帝、水君全數招募後）時，解鎖透明鈴鐺的製作配方。製作後使用鈴鐺，鳳王便會從天際降臨。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Found in Rocky Ridges. An alternative to Charmander for the Burn specialty. With its Burn ability, Torchic assists in kiln-baking Soft Clay into Bricks — a key material for the Rainbow Badge (×40) and various construction projects. Build a 啾啾餐 habitat in Rocky Ridges to attract it.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 出現於岩石山脊，是擁有燃燒專長的替代夥伴（可替代小火龍）。火稚雞的燃燒能力可協助將軟泥窯烤成磚塊——彩虹徽章的關鍵材料之一（×40）。在岩石山脊建造「啾啾餐」棲息地可吸引火稚雞。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The gateway to the Dream Islands. Entrust a Pokémon doll to Drifloon and it will carry you to a randomly generated Dream Island where Johto Legendary Beasts await. The type of doll determines the island biome — for example, a Pikachu doll leads to an ocean-type island where Raikou can be found in the deep cave.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 通往夢境群島的門戶。將寶可夢娃娃交給飄飄球，牠會帶你前往隨機生成的夢境群島，城都傳說三聖獸便棲居於此。娃娃的種類決定島嶼的生物群系類型——例如皮卡丘娃娃會通往海洋型島嶼，雷公藏身於深洞之中。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Professor Tangrowth — Ditto's mentor and guide throughout the adventure. This vine-covered Pokémon discovered and awakened Ditto, introduced the world's backstory, and teaches core mechanics. At the end of the game, Professor Tangrowth celebrates alongside Ditto with party poppers and sends the Precious Photo into space.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 巨蔓藤博士——百變怪整段旅程中的導師與引路人。這隻渾身藤蔓的寶可夢發現並喚醒了百變怪，向牠說明世界的由來並傳授核心玩法。遊戲結尾，巨蔓藤博士與百變怪並肩燃放派對拉炮，共同將珍愛照片送入太空。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Eevee's grass-type evolution. Unlock condition: harvest 100 crops total across Palette Town's farm plots to unlock the Sandwich recipe.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 伊布的草系進化型。解鎖條件：在真新鎮農田合計收成 100 株農作物，解鎖「三明治」食譜。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Eevee's ice-type evolution. Unlock condition: reach the highest elevation point in Palette Town's terrain (the summit of the tallest island peak) to unlock the Shaved Ice recipe.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 伊布的冰系進化型。解鎖條件：抵達真新鎮地形的最高海拔點（最高島嶼山頂），解鎖「刨冰」食譜。

pokemon.descriptionEn: A named story character — a Rotom that serves as the town's resident DJ. It supplies the music and ambient energy that bring your restored settlements to life, spinning tracks as the community grows.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 具名劇情角色——擔任城鎮駐場 DJ 的洛托姆（Rotom）。牠提供音樂與氛圍能量，隨著聚落成長放送樂曲，為你復興的據點注入生氣。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Build a Construction Generator habitat in Sparkling Skylands to attract this master builder. Essential for the concrete production chain — it operates the Concrete Mixer and processes Limestone (yielded by Golem's Crush ability) into usable Concrete. Also a required construction crew member for the Huge Building reconstruction.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 於閃耀空島建造「工地發電機」棲息地可吸引這位建造大師。混凝土生產鏈的核心——負責操作混凝土攪拌機，將由隆隆岩粉碎取得的石灰岩加工成可用混凝土。同時也是重建巨大建築所需施工團隊的必要成員。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The ecological backbone of Bleak Beach. Build a garbage collection station to attract Trubbish. Its Recycle specialty serves two critical functions: converting non-combustible waste into iron ore (used for iron ingots and shower construction), and processing waste paper collected in Sparkling Skylands into usable Paper (required for Thunder Badge ×10 and Huge Building 4F ×10). Its evolution Garbodor (灰塵山) anchors the late-game automation trio.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 荒涼海灘的生態核心。建造垃圾收集站可吸引破破袋。其「回收」專長承擔兩項關鍵功能：將不可燃垃圾轉化為鐵礦（用於冶煉鐵錠及建造淋浴間），以及將在閃耀空島收集的廢紙加工成可用紙張（雷電徽章 ×10 及巨大建築 4F ×10 的必要材料）。其進化型灰塵山（Garbodor）是後期自動化三人組的支柱。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Eevee's fairy-type evolution. Unlock condition: encounter 10 different Pokémon species within Palette Town to unlock the Ribbon Cake recipe. Sylveon's presence brightens the overall atmosphere of the endgame sandbox.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 伊布的妖精系進化型。解鎖條件：在真新鎮範圍內遭遇合計 10 種不同的寶可夢，解鎖「緞帶蛋糕」食譜。仙子伊布的出現會為終局沙盒的整體氛圍增添明亮色彩。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Chef Dente is a Greedent found trapped inside a building in Rocky Ridges. Bake and eat wheat bread to gain the strength to cut his chains and free him. Once rescued, Chef Dente cooks key dishes — including the Burger Patty that upgrades Ditto's Rock Smash. He must later be escorted to Sparkling Skylands to help build the 3rd floor of the Huge Building.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 主廚 Dente 是一隻被困在岩石山脊建築物內的貪心栗鼠（Greedent）。烤製並食用小麥麵包以獲得切斷鎖鏈、救出牠的力量。獲救後，主廚 Dente 會烹調關鍵料理——包括能強化百變怪碎岩能力的漢堡排。之後還須護送牠前往閃耀空島，協助建造摩天大樓的 3 樓。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Tinkmaster is a Tinkaton master smith in Sparkling Skylands. Bring concrete and iron ingots to commission Special Gears, which are used to craft the Lift Platforms needed to traverse the floating islands. An indispensable engineering ally for opening up the Skylands.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 巨鍛匠是棲身於閃耀空島的鍛造大師——巨鉗螳螂（Tinkaton）。帶上混凝土與鐵錠即可委託製作特殊齒輪，用於打造跨越漂浮島嶼所需的升降平台。是開拓空島不可或缺的工程盟友。
